question: What preliminary elements and deity are assigned to the three-syllabled Sarasvatī mantra?
premises: The seer and other preliminaries are as stated for the ten-syllabled mantra.
The goddess is the three-syllabled Sarasvatī.
inference: The three-syllabled Sarasvatī mantra adopts the same preliminary elements as the ten-syllabled mantra and has Sarasvatī as its deity.
plain_english: The seer and so forth are as stated for the ten-syllabled mantra; the goddess is the three-syllabled Sarasvatī.
